snippet.title: FRIDAY NIGHT INCIDENT V2 OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY
snippet.description:
After 4 long years, Friday Night Incident V2 HAS DROPPED!!!
Thank you to everyone who has waited patiently as we worked tirelessly on releasing this. It means the world to finally say that Friday Night Incident is finished and that we have something to present, and with that, HAVE FUN!!!

https://gamejolt.com/games/fridaynightincident/645374
https://gamebanana.com/mods/616627

This mod includes a total of 14 songs, an expanded story from the original first update and the V2 demo, complete with revamps made to dated and old assets. Two difficulty levels are available: "CANON" for those who want to play the mod as intended and seek a challenge, and "CASUAL" for those who prefer a more relaxed experience.
